# America Car Transport

> America Car Transport (americacartransport.com) is a nationwide auto transport broker that ships cars, SUVs, pickup trucks and motorcycles between all 50 U.S. states. It arranges open and enclosed transport with licensed, insured carriers, door-to-door pickup and delivery, and requires no upfront deposit. Quotes are free online or by phone at (530) 725-5383, in English or Spanish.

## Key facts

- Service area: all 50 U.S. states (Hawaii and Alaska by ocean freight). Domestic U.S. shipping only.
- Average cost to ship a car between states: about $500 to $1,600 for a sedan on an open carrier.
- Typical ranges by distance (sedan, open carrier): under 500 miles $400 to $850; 500 to 1,500 miles $700 to $1,250; over 1,500 miles (coast to coast) $1,050 to $1,750.
- Cost per mile: about $1.20 to $2.20 under 500 miles, $0.40 to $0.70 coast to coast.
- Vehicle and service adjustments: SUV or minivan about +10 to 15%; pickup truck about +15 to 20%; enclosed transport about +40 to 60%; non-running vehicles need a winch and add a fee.
- Transit time once picked up: 1 to 3 days regional, 3 to 5 days mid-distance, 6 to 9 days coast to coast. Carrier assignment usually takes 1 to 5 days after booking.
- Cheapest time to ship: late winter and early spring. Busiest and most expensive: summer moving season and the fall snowbird season toward Florida and Arizona.
- Documents needed: photo ID, vehicle registration or title, proof of insurance; the Bill of Lading is signed at pickup and delivery.
- No upfront deposit is required to book.
